title: Land backing onto Sap Pradu reservoir, mountain view
summary: ที่ดินติดอ่างเก็บน้ำซับประดู่: back of the plot on the reservoir, mountain view on the side, hills of a national-park forest around. Piped water and power. 33 m frontage. About 3 h / 213 km from Bangkok (post).
where: ต.มิตรภาพ อ.สีคิ้ว จ.นครราชสีมา (Sap Pradu reservoir, Sikhio)
waterfront: reservoir (claimed in post; photos show the shore)
loc_basis: Sap Pradu reservoir (Google Maps); the plot is somewhere on its shore
warning: Post mentions national-park forest nearby; the reservoir shore may be RID land. Check the title on LandsMaps.

title: 30 rai with water on two sides, below Khun Dan Prakan Chon dam
summary: ที่ดินติดน้ำ 2 ด้าน วิวเขื่อนขุนด่านฯ: 30 rai + almost 10 rai accreted land, 260 m from Nang Rong waterfall, water on two sides (streams below the dam, flowing all year). Pitched for a resort.
where: near Nang Rong waterfall / Khun Dan Prakan Chon dam, จ.นครนายก
waterfront: stream/river (two sides), not the reservoir itself
loc_basis: Nang Rong waterfall (Google Maps); post says 260 m away
warning: Next to Khao Yai NP; accreted land (ที่งอก) is usually not on the title. Check on LandsMaps.

title: 2 rai on a clear stream near Sai Thong reservoir, mountain view
summary: ติดลำธารกว่า 200 เมตร: over 200 m of stream frontage, clear water, close mountain view, 45 m above sea level, never floods, near Sai Thong reservoir. Pitched for tents/homestay/cafe/pool villa.
where: ต.เขาพระ อ.เมือง จ.นครนายก
title_deed: โฉนดครุฑแดง
waterfront: stream (200+ m frontage), not a lake
search: ขอบอ่างเก็บน้ำมาบประชัน 31 ไร่ (surfaced by FB)
loc_basis: between Khao Phra subdistrict and Sai Thong reservoir (Google Maps)
warning: Price not stated ('special price, ask'). Streams off Khao Yai's south edge: check the plot is outside the NP on LandsMaps.

title: 2-rai lots backing onto water, Wang Katha, Pak Chong

title_deed: โฉนดครุฑแดง
